description: This Java class defines built-in authorization context types within the Ditto framework, specifically providing static constants for different authorization contexts and utility methods related to them.

classes.name: DittoAuthorizationContextType
classes.description: A final class extending AuthorizationContextType, representing specific, built-in authorization context types used in Ditto, such as JWT, pre-authenticated HTTP headers, and connection-based contexts.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns an array of all predefined DittoAuthorizationContextType instances.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the provided AuthorizationContextType is one of the predefined Ditto types.
